citations.excerpt: # Bore Well Maintenance`nVillage water reliability failures often involve bore well downtime, weak maintenance accountability, delayed pump repair, and poor spare-parts availability. Field officers should validate local survey evidence before recommending repair governance changes.

This is synthetic test data. Rural water reliability problems may be associated with bore well downtime, delayed pump maintenance, summer source depletion, and unclear repair accountability. Field validation should compare household survey responses, evidence notes, and seasonal service records.

Approved rural water reliability guidance: delayed bore well maintenance, repair accountability, village water committee monitoring, and verified scheme facilitation may reduce household water shortages. Eligibility must be verified by local officials before benefits are claimed.
